Shivani knows Mahendra as society chairman and programme organizer. He has demonstrated flirty attention in Shreya SR04 and Soniya TS11; his current Shivani-directed attraction is new author direction, not falsely backdated to an earlier encounter.

beats.title: The same scooty ride back
beats.plot: Scene 02 ends ~17:20. Shivani walks from staffroom to her parked scooty, leaves college around 17:20 and travels home using the established morning 25-minute journey as a planning baseline. Professional campus outfit, bag, dupatta and helmet unchanged. Her husband's personal New Year surprise from morning remains pending. She has no knowledge of unauthorized copying of her unsent photo.

beats.title: Mahendra Suri — chairman's personal interest
beats.plot: At society parking, Mahendra appears with children's programme proof sheet. The genuine society task is his plausible opener, but he uses it to hold Shivani in conversation beyond the work requirement. Narrator distinguishes his lingering, body-focused gaze (outfit line front/back and her moving silhouette) from Shivani's actual awareness. He offers a pointed, suggestive personal compliment rather than another generic 'good work' statement. Shivani recognizes the personal turn and pushes back playfully but firmly. No touch or implied consent. Mahendra privately wants another opportunity to talk to her; separate from his earlier Shreya and Soniya incidents.

dialogue.speaker: Mahendra
dialogue.line: Shivani ji, aaj aapki kurti ki fitting front aur back dono taraf se kaafi attention kheench rahi hai. Chairman ka concentration bhi test ho raha hai.

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Chairman sahab, aapka inspection society ka hai ya mera? Aapki nazar kuch zyada personal ho rahi hai.

dialogue.speaker: Mahendra
dialogue.line: Aap toh meri har baat pakad leti hain.

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Phir sambhal kar bola kijiye. Children's programme ka print dikhaaiye.

beats.reaction: Mahendra is momentarily disarmed but still interested; Shivani keeps the agenda and ends on her own terms. Do not render sexual attention as reciprocal invitation.

beats.title: Ayaan and Armaan — re-entry without false first meeting
beats.plot: Ayaan and Armaan arrive together with revised poster proofs and a folding lightweight display stand. One-line grounding: Shivani already knows their society-printwork and remembers their attention to tiny details; readers have seen the pair in Ankita A06. Ayaan begins warmly and loudly, Armaan first presents the corrected QR print. Mahendra stays briefly to collect materials. Other society characters are not teleported into this grouping.

dialogue.speaker: Ayaan
dialogue.line: Shivani ma'am, aaj finally proof approve karwa hi lete hain. Hum dono ki itni mehnat kuch toh deserve karti hai.

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Pehle spelling aur QR scan pass karo. Compliments ka result uske baad.

dialogue.speaker: Armaan
dialogue.line: Proof perfect hai, ma'am. Aapki inspection se bachne ke liye extra checking ki hai.

beats.title: One consequential shared-stand incident
beats.plot: While opening the fold-out sample beside the wall, a loose stand leg shifts as Shivani reaches to steady the proof sheet. Armaan moves quickly and catches her by the clothed side/waist for balance while Ayaan secures the paper, then releases once she is steady. Shivani briefly grips Armaan's shoulder, steps back, and checks the stand. It is a clear new physical incident, not imagined prehistory, and their proximate looks/quick reaction matter more than a prolonged psychological speech. Armaan's surprisingly direct response catches Ayaan's attention; the trio share a charged, brief beat; Shivani stays in control.

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Armaan, stand pehle lock karo. Mujhe hi rehearsal prop mat bana dena.

dialogue.speaker: Armaan
dialogue.line: Sorry ma'am. Aap safe hain — stand ko ab doosra chance nahi dunga.

dialogue.speaker: Ayaan
dialogue.line: Armaan, tum toh silently hero ban gaye. Main abhi bhi poster pakad raha hoon.

beats.reaction: Shivani notices Armaan's confidence and chooses to turn the moment back to practical work; neither man invents permission to prolong touch.

beats.title: Shared future hook and home cutoff
beats.plot: Shivani signs off or flags the corrections on the sample and directs them to coordinate with Sharmi/Deepu. Ayaan invites another review round; Armaan adds one well-timed teasing line. Shivani smiles at the challenge but leaves for Tower C to check on Tara and Kavya. Mahendra is no longer in the foreground. Cut before home conversation. No Karan/Aman at this time because Ankita Scene 07 occupies them from 17:20–17:50.
